regulations.notes: South Lake Tahoe has a VHR (Vacation Home Rental) permit system with caps per neighborhood/block to prevent saturation. The city restricts the density of VHRs in residential areas to preserve neighborhood character. A VHR permit, business license, and TOT registration are required. Parking minimums apply. The permit cap system means permits may not be available in all neighborhoods.
